title: Chapter 354 - 354 Hello, Mr. Lin; Boarding!
content:
Chapter 354 - 354 Hello, Mr. Lin; Boarding!

Chapter 354 - 354 Hello, Mr. Lin; Boarding!

354 Hello, Mr. Lin; Boarding!

Not long ago, Jack Smith suddenly learned that Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel had changed owners.

Moreover, it was a new boss from Hua Nation.

This made Jack Smith unable to sleep.

Therefore, when it was 9:30 AM in Hua Nation and 3:00 AM in Eagle Country, Jack Smith could not help but make a call.

He wanted to talk to his new boss as soon as possible and build a relationship with him.

Otherwise…

He had worked hard for so many years to become the chairman of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel.

Perhaps it would not be long before everything was ruined.

“Mr. Lin, I’m going to report to you about the hotel’s situation in the first half of the year, as well as the plans for the next year. Are you free?” Jack Smith asked.

Lin Fan said, “Forget it. I’ll be flying to Eagle Country today.”

When Jack Smith heard this, his figure turned solemn, and he hurriedly said, “Alright, I’ll get ready to pick you up!”

“Okay.” Lin Fan said, “Oh right, aren’t you from Eagle Country? Why do you speak Hua Nation’s language so fluently?”

Jack Smith said, “Because there are many tourists from all over the world who come to our hotel. I used to receive tourists from all over the world, so I learned the languages of many countries.”

Lin Fan said, “Not bad.”

Although it was just a simple word of praise, to Jack Smith, it sounded like a beautiful symphony. It was so pleasant that his entire face was filled with smiles.

After breakfast, Lin Fan took his ID card, passport, and other documents before driving the Cullinan.

Not long after, he pressed a doorbell.

The door slowly opened.

Chu Yunyue’s beautiful face appeared in front of him.

The two of them had not seen each other for a while.

Now that they met, there was no need to say anything. They were like magnets that directly embracing embraced each other.

The sun continued to rise, and the trees swayed gently…

About three hours later, Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue both changed into a new set of clothes and walked out of the room.

“I’m on my way…”

Chu Yunyue said a few simple words and hung up.

Then, she looked at the Culinan’s interior curiously and said, “As expected of a Culinan. Be it material, comfort, or power, they’re all top-notch…

“The space in the back row is also very large. It won’t be a problem to lie down and sleep.”

Lin Fan said, “Really? Why don’t you sleep here next time?”

Chu Yunyue seemed to have thought of something, and her face turned red.

They chatted while driving and soon arrived at the airport.

In the distance, an oval-faced woman in a dress kept waving and calling out, “Director Chu, Mr. Lin, we’re here!”

Chu Yunyue and Lin Fan walked forward together.

“Hello, Chairwoman Chu, Mr. Lin.”

Obviously, these people were all Flower Stem’s employees.

When Chu Yunyue was alone with Lin Fan, she was like a little girl who did not know anything.

However, in front of the company’s employees, she was like a cold CEO, extremely strict and imposing.

The oval-faced woman asked, “Chairwoman Chu, may I know which plane we’re taking to Eagle Country?”

Yesterday, she was about to book a plane ticket when she suddenly received a call from Chu Yunyue. She said that the plane tickets were ready and they could go straight to the airport tomorrow.

However, Chu Yunyue did not say which flight it was.

Chu Yunyue did not answer her. Instead, she looked at Lin Fan.

It was because she did not know which flight it was either.

Yesterday, Lin Fan only told her that he had arranged the plane.

Lin Fan said, “The plane should be in front. Let’s go.”

Everyone did not ask much and followed Lin Fan.

When they arrived in front of Xia Airlines’ shuttle, three beautiful air stewardesses bowed in unison and said, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

The air stewardess standing at the front smiled and said, “Mr. Lin, do you want to board the plane now or rest in the VIP lounge first?”

“Yunyue, do you want to rest and eat something first?” Lin Fan asked.

Chu Yunyue shook her head. “Let’s just go straight to the plane. There should be food on the plane.”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Alright, let’s go to the plane.”

Thus, three air stewardesses led Lin Fan and the others to check their passports and identity documents.

Then, they strolled through the passage and took a Mercedes-Benz bus straight to the airplane.

Seeing this…

A few people could not help but discuss in low voices.

“Did you notice? I don’t think we collected or checked our flight tickets, right?”

“Huh, it seems so!”

“Then how did we get in?”

“The shuttle bus at the airport in the past was just an ordinary one, right? How did it switch to a Benz today?”

Amidst the crowd’s discussion, the Mercedes-Benz bus stopped steadily in front of a luxury passenger plane.

Lin Fan and the others had just gotten off the Mercedes-Benz bus… A group of tall, beautiful air stewardesses with exquisite facial features who scored above 85 points in appearance stood in two rows. They bowed at the same time. “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

This scene…

The staff of Flower Stem, as well as Chu Yunyue, were stunned.

Such a scene… Let alone in reality, they had never seen it before even in TV shows.

Following that, everyone could not help but look at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and said, “Let’s go. Let’s get on the plane.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he held Chu Yunyue’s slender hand and walked past the two rows of beautiful air stewardesses.

At this moment…

Chu Yunyue suddenly had a strange feeling. It was as if… she was wearing a snow-white wedding dress. Under the witness of her relatives and friends, she was holding hands with Lin Fan as they walked onto the stage.

Chu Yunyue, who had always been calm and collected, blushed when she thought of this.

Lin Fan asked, “You seem to be sweating. Are you feeling hot?”

Chu Yunyue stammered, “Yes… That’s right.

Lin Fan said, “Then let’s go quickly. It’ll be fine once we get on the plane.”

“Yes, yes!” Chu Yunyue nodded vigorously.

When everyone got on the plane, they saw that there was no one inside, and it seemed very spacious.

As soon as everyone sat down, the beautiful air stewardesses who were standing in two rows earlier walked over.

The air stewardess at the front smiled and asked, “Mr. Lin, are all the guests here?”

Lin Fan did not reply. Instead, he looked at Chu Yunyue.

Chu Yunyue looked at the people on the plane and said, “They’re all here.”

“Then I’ll ask the captain to contact the control tower and prepare to head to Lun City, Eagle Country.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright,” the air stewardess said.
